title: Async reset passed to HTTPStream in sync pool
detail: The `_reset` method is async but is passed as a callback to `HTTPStream` in the synchronous `send` method. The callback will be called without awaiting, so the reset logic never runs.

title: Async parser reset called without await in sync pool
detail: In the synchronous pool, `_reset` calls the async `self._parser.reset()` without awaiting it, creating an unawaited coroutine and skipping the reset logic.

title: Async reset called without await in sync server
detail: In the synchronous `handle_requests` loop, `self._reset()` is an async coroutine but is called without `await`. This creates a coroutine that is never awaited, leading to a warning and the reset logic never executing.
